answer: Yes. The ferry cable disappearing into fog “as if it led nowhere” subtly connects Ilse’s familiar routine with uncertainty and emotional isolation. Her remark, “Das Seil weiß, wo’s langgeht” (“The cable knows the way”), personifies the cable and suggests her reliance on routine when human connections are harder to navigate—a tension reinforced when she leaves Jonas’s call unanswered. These restrained metaphors deepen the story without explicitly explaining its emotional stakes.
